description: The numbered module catalog. Claude Code reads this file to resolve instructions like 'use module 5' to a real component, its default animation effects, and which named elements inside it are meant to be adjustable (see 'editable').

modules.name: CTA — Two Choice

modules.name: CTA — Testimonial Combo

modules.name: CTA — Spotlight Banner

modules.name: CTA — Minimal Inline
modules.description: A single thin bar — one line of copy and a text link, no card or heavy padding.

modules.name: CTA — App Download
modules.description: Split closing section for a mobile app: copy + store badges left, phone mockup right.

modules.name: CTA — Contact Form
modules.description: A closing section with an inline contact form instead of a single button, for sales-assisted products.

modules.name: Footer — App Download

modules.name: Footer — Dark

modules.name: Footer — CTA Strip

modules.name: Footer — Sitemap
modules.description: Dense 6-column footer for large sites with a lot to link to. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Hero — Illuminated Glow
modules.description: Full-viewport black hero with warm/cool blurred glow blobs fading in behind centered copy, and a neon text-shadow glow on the highlighted headline line. Adapted from 21st.dev's Illuminated Hero.

modules.name: Content — Carousel Card
modules.description: One large image + copy card at a time, stepped through with prev/next controls and dot pagination. Local carousel state, not part of the A-J catalog. Adapted from 21st.dev's Carousel Card.

editable.heading: A
editable.cards: custom carousel state (AnimatePresence crossfade), see file

modules.name: Gallery — Accordion
modules.description: A row of panels where the active one expands and reveals its label while the rest compress, grey out, and tilt away in 3D. Hover or arrow-key through them. Adapted from ReactBits' AccordionGallery, rebuilt on Motion instead of GSAP.

editable.heading: A
editable.panels: custom hover-driven flexGrow/rotate/parallax via Motion, see file

modules.name: Hero — Image Stream
modules.description: Two rails of image cards ride from far behind the screen toward the viewer on pure CSS 3D perspective, forming a continuous corridor. Adapted from 21st.dev's Image Stream Hero.

editable.title: B
editable.images: custom CSS-keyframe corridor (no JS animation loop), see file

modules.name: Hero — Container Scroll Reveal
modules.description: A rounded device frame tilts back in 3D perspective at rest, then straightens and scales up as the page scrolls past, revealing a product image inside. Adapted from Aceternity's Container Scroll Animation.

editable.title: custom scroll-linked translateY, see file
editable.card: custom scroll-linked rotateX/scale via Motion, see file

modules.name: Gallery — Morph Slider
modules.description: A WebGL image slider that crossfades slides through a shader-driven pixel displacement (a scrolling noise field warps one image apart as the next resolves) instead of a CSS crossfade. Drag or use the arrow controls. Adapted from a community ogl + GSAP MorphSlider component.

editable.heading: A
editable.slides: custom WebGL canvas driven by `motion/react`'s animate(), see file

modules.name: Gallery — Dome
modules.description: A wraparound sphere of image tiles built from CSS 3D transforms. Drag to rotate with flick inertia; click a tile to open it into a centered full-size view. Adapted from a community DomeGallery component, its drag gesture rebuilt on plain pointer events instead of @use-gesture/react.

editable.heading: A
editable.sphere: custom CSS 3D transforms + imperative open/close DOM choreography, see file

modules.name: Showcase — Split-Flap Display
modules.description: An airport/train-station departures-board effect: tiles mechanically flip through a few random characters before landing on each message, cycling through a status-message list on a loop. Adapted from a community SplitFlapText component.

editable.heading: A
editable.board: custom flip-cycle text array, see file

modules.name: Gallery — Depth Carousel
modules.description: A stack of cards receding into a CSS 3D perspective, stepping the focused card forward on drag, scroll-wheel, arrow keys, or the prev/next controls while the rest fall back in depth, darken, and blur. Adapted from a community DepthCarousel component, its GSAP tween rebuilt on `motion/react`'s animate().

editable.heading: A
editable.cards: custom drag/wheel/keyboard-driven 3D transform carousel, see file

modules.name: Nav — Card Menu
modules.description: A collapsed pill nav that expands downward into a row of colored, themed link cards, then collapses back on toggle. Adapted from a community CardNav component, its GSAP timeline rebuilt on `motion/react`'s animate() (per-card delay for the stagger, `.then()` for the close callback).

editable.heading: A
editable.cards: custom measured expand/collapse + stagger via motion/react's animate(), see file

modules.name: Footer — Boxed Panel
modules.description: A footer framed as its own bordered, rounded card rather than a full-width band — brand mark, nav column, mission statement, and socials on top, an inline newsletter field and legal row below. No entrance animation.

modules.name: Footer — Status Console
modules.description: A dispatch-style newsletter panel — headline, signup, and topic tags on one side, a live status readout on the other — sits above the standard column footer. No entrance animation.

modules.name: Footer — Bold Color Card
modules.description: A saturated gradient card carries the whole footer — brand, description, socials, and link columns — with the copyright line sitting outside it on the plain page background. No entrance animation.

modules.name: Footer — Oversized Wordmark
modules.description: A restrained top half — brand, tagline, bordered nav grid — gives way to an enormous, barely-there brand wordmark cropped off at the bottom edge. No entrance animation.

modules.name: Footer — Photo Frame
modules.description: A strip of environmental photography sits above a rounded dark panel like a card laid over a full-bleed photo — centered brand, a slim link row, socials, and a two-line meta readout in the legal row. No entrance animation.

modules.name: Showcase — Scroll Reveal Manifesto
modules.description: A pinned full-bleed statement over a photo where the text fills in word-by-word, continuously tracking scroll position (not a one-time entrance) — a few key words highlight in an accent color as they land. Bold display font, swappable in registry/lib/display-font.ts.

editable.words/emphasis: custom scroll-scrubbed word array, see file

modules.name: Showcase — Dual Scroll Marquee
modules.description: Two oversized text rows loop continuously in opposite directions, one mixing in photo chips from the library, with an added scroll-linked drift on top of the idle loop so both rows visibly react as you scroll past. Bold display font, swappable in registry/lib/display-font.ts.

modules.name: Hero — Statement Dark
modules.description: A flat, austere dark hero: eyebrow, huge two-line statement on Effect K, subhead paragraph, no CTA buttons. The click-to-play video facade beneath it lives in its own pinned section — it zooms to near-fullscreen and loses its rounded corners, then holds pinned so there's real dwell time to watch it before it releases and scrolls away. Reuses module 29's YouTube-facade pattern and video ID.

modules.name: Stats — Animated Bar Chart
modules.description: Dark section, three columns whose fill grows from the bottom, each gated to its own slice of the pinned section's scroll progress rather than triggered on enter, so they fill strictly by scroll distance and reverse cleanly on scroll-up. A big percentage label rides the top edge of each fill, with a caption below. Pinned from sm up; below sm the section unpins and flows, since the stacked single-column content is taller than a phone viewport.

modules.name: Showcase — Blur Exit Statement
modules.description: A pinned full-screen statement that fades in, holds, then blurs and scales up as the section scrolls past — a punctuation moment between bigger sections. Bespoke scroll wiring, not part of the A-K catalog.

modules.name: Content — Resources Stack
modules.description: A 'Playbook' section: intro paragraph and real internal links in a sticky left column, a tightly overlapping fan of cards on the right that fade/rise/rotate in with a shared stagger (Effect F-style) and then stay put together. Bespoke stagger variant, not part of the A-K catalog.

modules.name: CTA — Rotating Word Closer
modules.description: A playful closer: 'Design Real' / a 3-up coverflow carousel (dimmed prev/next images flanking a sharp raised center image) that cycles on a timer / '[word] Systems.' beneath, plus a small credit line. Effect B on the static lines.

modules.name: Nav — Scroll Chapter Pill
modules.description: A floating pill that relabels itself as you scroll, tracking the current chapter by scanning the named sections on each scroll and keeping the last one whose top edge has crossed a line near the top of the viewport — deliberately a scan rather than IntersectionObserver, which would lose the label once you scroll past the final chapter; hamburger opens a jump-link dropdown of all chapters. Host page must give each chapter section a matching id attribute. Optional mobileAlign="end" parks the pill in the top-right corner below sm, for pages where a centred pill would sit on top of full-bleed pinned content.

editable.chapters prop: array of {id, label}; ids must match the host page's section ids

modules.name: Hero — Cinematic Curtain
modules.description: A 440vh pinned opening sequence in six scrubbed beats: backdrop settles from a 1.12 zoom, headline lifts away, a hairline of accent colour draws out of the centre point on scaleY then wipes outward on scaleX to flood the frame, two stills reveal through expanding clip-paths (rectangle then diamond), a closing still scales up from zero under an accent tint with a centred heading, then splits down the middle and slides apart to uncover a light panel with a statement rising into it. Every beat runs off one shared scrollYProgress, so it rewinds exactly on scroll-up.

editable.headline: newlines become separate lines
editable.accent: #7a0c07 — curtain colour and the closing frame's mix-blend-overlay tint
editable.zoomHeading: heading inside the closing frame; splits in half with it
editable.revealLabel / revealStatement: the light panel uncovered by the split
editable.SLIDES array: the three reveal stills, see file

modules.name: Content — Drag Slider
modules.description: A label, an oversized statement, and a row of cards you drag sideways, with a spring-tracked DRAG tag following the cursor over the rail; a figures row closes the section. Uses Motion's drag="x" with measured constraints rather than overflow scrolling, because the Lenis wrapper owns wheel events site-wide.

editable.title: Built on judgement, not inventory
editable.CARDS array: image, label, caption per card — see file

modules.name: Stats — Column Scroller
modules.description: A full-screen pinned section: three columns of oversized figures sit across the top of the frame aligned left/centre/right, and each advances to its next stat at a different scroll point so a round ripples across the frame. The standfirst and full-bleed backdrop change together, but only after a full round of column swaps completes. Edge-to-edge by design — no vignette, no inner scroll mask. Opacity routes through useScrollValue (pinned frame).

editable.COLUMNS array: align + stats per column — see file
editable.COLUMN_STEPS: progress points at which each column advances

modules.name: Gallery — Counter-Scroll Cases
modules.description: A 260vh pinned case index: two rows of numbered work slide past each other in opposite directions through the pin — Effect H's parallax logic on a horizontal axis, one row negative and one positive. Each row renders its items twice so neither end runs out of cards mid-travel.

editable.title: Selected work
editable.ROW_A / ROW_B arrays: number, name, image per case — see file

modules.name: Services — Title Rotator
modules.description: A services block shown one at a time: the headline rotates vertically line by line out of its own mask while the image panel crossfades in step and a counter reads 01 / 03. Advances on a 6s timer and on prev/next; interacting resets the timer rather than killing autoplay. Runs on its own clock — no pin, no useScroll.

editable.SERVICES array: title lines, blurb, image per service — see file

modules.name: Showcase — Perspective Expand
modules.description: A 420vh pinned section where one image carries the whole transition: it starts as a small 3D-tilted card, rotates flat and grows to full bleed, then becomes the backdrop for an oversized headline revealing line by line out of its own mask, with a benefits list fading up underneath. Growth interpolates width/height inside calc() against --card-w/--card-h so the card's start size can vary per breakpoint and stays landscape on a phone.

editable.TITLE_LINES array: one entry per headline line — see file
editable.--card-w / --card-h: the card's start size, set per breakpoint on the card's className

modules.name: Content — Sticky Split Scroller
modules.description: A two-column section where the left column pins (label, oversized statement, standing CTA) while the right scrolls short blocks past it, alternating flush-left and flush-right. Built on plain CSS position:sticky plus Effect G per block rather than a scrubbed pin, because nothing here needs to reverse. Collapses to one stacked column below lg.

editable.title: The network is the product
editable.BLOCKS array: label, optional figure, body, and left/right alignment per block — see file

modules.name: Team — Split Slider
modules.description: A full-height split panel — portrait on one side, name and biography on the other — advanced with prev/next. Both halves swap on the same beat but travel in opposite vertical directions, so it reads as one card being turned over. Direction is tracked in state and passed to the variants as a custom value, so stepping backwards genuinely reverses the motion.

editable.TEAM array: name lines, role, bio, image per member — see file

modules.name: Contact — Statement Form
modules.description: A closing conversion block: an oversized statement revealed line by line on scroll, then a deliberately plain underline-only form with staggered field entry (Effect F) and a contact column alongside. Presentational only — fields carry names and labels but there is no submit handler, so the host page wires action/method or onSubmit to its own backend.

editable.note: the reassurance line beside the form
editable.FIELDS array: name, label, placeholder, type per field — see file

modules.name: Locations — Tabbed Panel
modules.description: A full-height office panel: tabs across the top, an oversized city name, a description, and a strip of supporting photographs over a backdrop that crossfades on tab change. Each location shows its own live local time, rendered client-only (blank during SSR) so the clock cannot cause a hydration mismatch.

editable.LOCATIONS array: city, IANA timeZone, building, blurb, backdrop, and four thumbs per location — see file
